environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on EC2 behind AWS ALB. AWS WAFv2 WebACL is attached to the ALB with the following rule groups in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, (2) a custom rule group 'corp-api-restrict' containing a RegexPatternSet match on query string values with pattern '(?i)(?:case\s+when|union|select|from\s+|sqlite_|information_schema|sleep\s*\(|benchmark|extractvalue|updatexml|load_file|into\s+(?:out|dump)file|group\s+by.*having|order\s+by\s+(?:(?:case|if|sleep|benchmark)\s*\(|\d+\s*(?:--|#)))' set to BLOCK with 403 response, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in BLOCK mode. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch logging is enabled for the WebACL.

config.waf_rule_priority_2: custom rule group 'corp-api-restrict' with RegexPatternSet on QUERY_STRING values, BLOCK action
config.network: public-facing ALB, sg allows 443 inbound from any
config.auth: application-level Bearer token check (presence only, no validation)
